slides.title: Running total = [[gullak]]
points: Har mahine paisa gullak mein daalo
Gullak mein ab tak kitna? → **running total**
slides.note: Cumulative sum bhi kehte hain. Finance walon ka **fav** 💸

slides.title: [[SUM() OVER]]
slides.note: **ORDER BY** = jodne ka order. Bina iske poora total har row pe

slides.title: Har saal [[reset]]
slides.code:
SUM(amount) OVER (
  PARTITION BY year
  ORDER BY month_no
  ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
) AS ytd
slides.note: Same date wali rows? **ROWS** likho, warna tie wale same total paayenge

slides.wrong:
ORDER BY month
-- Apr, Feb, Jan, Mar 💀
slides.why: Month **text** hai to alphabet order sort hoga → running total galat
